title: New to this comp: need small help in getting started
author: Shayan Mandrekar
source: kaggle CLI: competitions topic-messages + topics show

messages.author: Shayan Mandrekar
messages.content_html:
Hi everyone,

I'm new to the competition and have been exploring the SDK locally using battle_start(), battle_select(), visualize_data(), and the observation objects.

A few questions for experienced participants or organizers:

  1. Is there documentation for the meanings of select.context and Option.type values, or are competitors expected to infer these from gameplay and the SDK source?

  2. Is there an officially recommended way to visualize/debug games locally beyond inspecting observations and logs? I've looked at visualize_data() and the Kaggle environment renderer, but I'm curious what workflow most participants are using.

  3. The SDK exposes search-related APIs (SearchBegin, SearchStep, SearchEnd). Are these intended to be used by agents for look-ahead planning/search, or are they mainly provided for analysis/debugging?

Any guidance would be greatly appreciated. Thanks!
